name: alert
purpose: Use Alert for a persistent message on a console page or section (info, warning, error) — the answer for 'banner' or 'notice'. A short confirmation after an action that disappears on its own is a Toast. Inline feedback banner that communicates status, alerts, or progress. Presents a severity-marked box (a neutral box for info, a soft tint for success, warning and danger, always with default text) with a leading icon, an optional bold `title` over the copy, and message copy that may carry inline links, plus an optional secondary action button.
useWhen: A status, warning or error that belongs to a page, section or form and should stay visible in context.
A notice with an inline link, or with one follow-up action (`actionLabel` or the `actions` slot).
A notice that needs a short headline and a sentence of detail (`title` over the copy): "Maintenance scheduled" over the window and what changes.
avoidWhen: A transient confirmation of an action → use `toast`.
Validation feedback under one form field → use `field-error`.
An admonition inside documentation prose → use `doc-callout`.
A promotional band between page sections → use `call-to-action` with `variant="announcement"`.
related: `toast` — overlay stack raised imperatively, auto-dismissing and not anchored to content.
`field-error` — field-level guidance and errors below an input.
`doc-callout` — docs admonition rendered on the `Alert` surface.
`empty-state` — a full zero-data block, not a status banner.
bestPractices: Pick `severity` by meaning. `danger` and `warning` render with `role="alert"`.
Use `label` for plain copy and the default slot when the copy needs inline links; each link is a `Link` with `inline`.

Set `title` when the alert says two things: what happened (the title, a few words, no end period) and what it means or what to do (the copy). A one-sentence alert needs no title. A title alone, with no copy, is allowed for a short notice that still wants the heading weight.
Use either the built-in action (`actionLabel` with `@action`) or the `actions` slot, not both. The slot replaces the button.

The `life` timer pauses while the pointer is over the alert or focus is inside it, and resumes with the time left when both leave, so the alert never disappears while it is being read or used. Keep `life` for `info` and `success` status messages.
Once `closable` or `life` dismisses the message, it stays hidden until it is remounted. Listen to `close` to keep your own state in sync.
Use `size="small"` inside dense surfaces such as cards and drawers.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token. Drives the banner height, inline padding, copy scale, and the trailing control sizes.

props.name: label
props.doc: Fallback message copy when the default slot is empty.

props.name: title
props.doc: Bold heading above the message copy; hidden when empty.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Azion icon class override for the leading icon.

props.name: actionLabel
props.doc: Label for the built-in secondary action button; hidden when empty.

props.name: closable
props.doc: When true, shows a close control that dismisses the message.

props.name: life
props.doc: Duration in milliseconds before auto-dismiss; `0` disables auto-dismiss.

events.name: action
events.notes: Emitted when the built-in action button is clicked.

events.name: close
events.notes: Emitted when the message is dismissed, after the fade. Carries the originating event: the close button's `MouseEvent`, the `Escape` `KeyboardEvent`, or an `Event` of type `timeout` after `life` expires.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: Custom action control; replaces the built-in Button when provided.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Alert copy. Inline content — plain text plus anchors, which the message region styles with the `.text-link` token — or flow content such as paragraphs and a list. The copy region is a flow container (a `div`, not a `p`), so block markup arriving from a server render stays inside it instead of being closed out beside the copy. Falls back to `label` when empty.
